query: A Tree by the Window Tobias wants you to grow a heartwood every evening for a week, "so your hands remember". Today he suggests the courtyard under your dormitory window, where nothing has grown in years. Grow it properly, roots and all It takes everything you've got and a blister. By dusk there's a young tree under your window, and your back aches like a harvest. Tobias says it's the best one he's seen, and apologises for saying so. Sit under his instead You let him grow it and sit under it with him, talking about nothing. Your hands don't remember much. The rest of you does.

results.title: Homesick
results.excerpt:
Homesick
Tobias has gone quiet. He's planted seedlings in every cup in the common room. "Harvest at home," he says. "First one I've missed. Ma's doing it alone."
Cheer him up with a joke
Your joke is terrible. He laughs anyway, the big rumbling laugh, and that seems to help.

results.title: It Hums
results.excerpt:
It Hums
You walk into the greenhouses with the heartwood wand, and every plant in the place leans toward it. Tobias looks up from his potting. "Oh," he says. "Oh, they like that. It's humming. Can you hear it? It's humming to them."
Let him listen
Tobias holds the wand to his ear
